gaps.title: Template library loading has no visible loading treatment
gaps.evidence: The frame is explicitly named Outreach library·loading, but the screenshot leaves the content region entirely blank while Create template, filters and Refresh remain visible.
gaps.why: A blank region cannot communicate pending vs empty/failed data, and the design does not specify which independent actions remain available.
gaps.request: Provide loading and load-error1440 variants showing skeleton/status text, keyboard focus and retry placement, and distinguish independent creation from actions requiring the loaded template list. Use the existing action contracts; no new operation is requested.
gaps.blocking: Visual/state composition gap; current safe explicit loading and refusal behavior must remain.

gaps.title: Denied Strategy view still advertises live freshness

gaps.why: A denied current read cannot establish current Strategy/context freshness.
gaps.request: Provide denied, expired, not-found and load-error header variants that either omit the badge or scope it to an independently verified source timestamp. Specify the exact label when no current read is available; avoid fabricated timers.
gaps.blocking: Truthful freshness visual acceptance; backend authority remains unchanged.
